post.description:
Save the user's word per row into the report, then type the apply call into the identity's running curation
session and stamp the applied rows as sent; a row already sent (and not reverted since) is refused. When no
session runs, the answer carries the call to paste.

get.description:
Every proposal the user discarded in this identity's curation reports, newest report first, with whether its
memory file changed since: a discarded proposal is not made again unless the file changed.

post.description:
Done on the page: the session-end call with no steps; a watcher then waits for the closing line and types
/exit. Its state is read from /run-state.
Type revert-applied-rows for one applied row into the curation session; the row counts as not sent again.

get.description: waiting, asked, exited after Done; open when Done was not sent.

post.description:
Start memory-curation's report in a terminal session of the identity, with its own agent config; a curation
session already running for it is returned instead of a second one.

get.description:
What the report page draws beside the report: the memory map and each row's diagram data, from the identity's
memory as it is now.

post.description:
Build the checkout's UI, then restart the server with the code on disk a moment after this answer; the UI waits
for a new `started`. A failed build leaves the running server as it is.

409.description: The UI build failed; the server keeps running, and the detail ends its output.

post.description:
Stop the server a moment after this answer, as Ctrl-C would; it starts again only from outside (the app or
`whaat serve`). Terminal sessions keep running in tmux.

get.description: Every identity for the admin; an identity sees only itself.

post.description:
Give an identity its own folder and token; only the admin can. The answer is the only place the UI shows the
token.

Replace an identity's token; only the admin can. The old token stops working at once, and the answer is the
only place the UI shows the new one.

memory-curation's report: one per day in the identity's private folder; a later save that day replaces it. A
row without what its actions require (a target, evidence, an existing memory) is refused, each named.
apply-rows' Applied cells on the identity's own curation report; the rest of the report stays as it is.

get.description:
The analysis of this identity's kept distillate, for the memory page's Elemzés to draw: the arc, the heatmap,
the autonomy ladder and changed views, the hub sessions and my reading.

The Emlékagy on this identity's memory graph: the whole page, or with embed only the drawing, for the memory page
to frame and drive (its chips, search and card are the page's). When the identity keeps a distillate, it is drawn
too, faint.
Every identity's memory for the admin, an identity's own for its token; for reading in the UI.

post.description:
memory-curation's judge brief for one dir: the skill's fixed text, how to read the dir and its candidates from
the lint's checks; the run passes it to its judge as it is, adding nothing.
memory-curation's refuter brief for one dir: the skill's fixed text and that dir's judge rows, as they came.

After a merge, split or trim: every sentence of the memory as it was, and whether the new text keeps it word
for word; the rest is the agent's to account for before the commit.
